messages.充電を消耗して斬撃脆弱と防御レベル減少を入れる、斬撃のデバッファー。: A Slash debuffer that spends Charge to inflict Slash Fragility and Defense Level Down.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「切断」の使用時・的中時、守備の戦闘開始時に充電回数が増える。: **Gaining Charge**: Charge Count increases on use and on hit of S1 Rip, and at Combat Start of his Defense skill. S1 also grants Slash Protection on use.
messages.S2「エネルギー循環」: 破裂を付与。Ⅲコイン的中時に充電回数3を消耗して斬撃脆: **S2 — Energy Cycle**: Inflicts Rupture. On Coin Ⅲ hit, spends 3 Charge Count to inflict 2 Slash Fragility.
messages.S3「エネルギー交流」: 各コイン的中時に充電回数2を消耗して防御レベル減少2を: **S3 — Energy Current**: On each Coin hit, spends 2 Charge Count to inflict 2 Defense Level Down (4 Coins).
messages.充電で強化: 充電回数5以上でS2・S3のコイン威力+1。: **Charge bonuses**: S2 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power at 5 or more Charge Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「耐え抜く」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 被ダメージ時とマ: **Combat passive — Enduring Spirit (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Charge Count increases by 1 when taking damage and on Clash Lose, up to 6 times each.
messages.S1や被弾で充電回数を貯め、S2で斬撃脆弱、S3で防御レベル減少を入れて味方の攻: Build Charge Count through S1 and taking hits, then inflict Slash Fragility with S2 and Defense Level Down with S3 to help allies' attacks land. S3 spends 2 Charge Count per Coin, so spending on all 4 Coins likely requires 8 Charge Count (the behavior when short is unconfirmed).
